question: A square piece of cloth has an area of 841 cm². What is the length of each of its diagonal?
solution:
**Given:**

Area of the square piece of cloth = 841 cm²

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c64b1c7fdf5031ac9b4ab8a0fda82994986b70f73eb4fa28931291280d7e62b6.png] 

Area of a square = a²

Diagonal of a square = a√2, where a → side of the square

**Calculation:**

Area of square piece cloth = 841 cm²

⇒ a² = 841

⇒ a = √841 

⇒ a = 29 cm

So, the diagonal of the cloth = a√2 = 29√2 cm

**∴ The length of each of its diagonal is 29√2 cm.**
